{{Quote|I am transmitting the coordinates of the target. Kill the guardians and bring the boy to me.|Thaum Rystra, ordering Tol Skaros to capture Caeleb and kill the boy's parents|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
The '''mother''' of the [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] [[Caeleb]] was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]] attempted to kidnap Caeleb and during an assault by Skaros on her family home, the woman was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Whiphid's [[Nek/Legends|nek battle dogs]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They'll take good care of each other.|Caeleb, to his Rebel rescuers, explaining his request that his mother and father be buried together|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
The mother of the [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] [[Caeleb]] was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The woman [[Marriage/Legends|wed]] a [[Caeleb's father|Force-sensitive man]] and they [[Reproduction/Legends|conceived]] a child, the boy [[Caeleb]],<ref name="Child of Light" /> who she gave birth to in around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Dates" /> While carrying Caeleb in her [[Womb/Legends|womb]] she sensed that that there was something special about her baby. She was subsequently proven to be correct: Caeleb possessed seemingly unlimited power in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was the subject of an ancient prophecy heralding the coming of a "Child of Light." Unknown to the woman, around one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to Caeleb's birth, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Duumas]] had predicted Caeleb's birth and merged his consciousness into a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] at an isolated spot on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] to created a bubble devoid of the Force as a safe haven for the child. The woman's husband received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the tree and, keen protect Caeleb from the Force until he was more mature, the couple settled with their boy in a homestead sited next to Duumas' tree.<ref name="Child of Light" />

The woman and her husband sought to give Caeleb had a happy childhood and they forbade him from crossing a stone wall that marked the boundary of the Force bubble surrounding their home.<ref name="Child of Light" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the family's quiet life was shattered when the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] sent his apprentice, the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Tol Skaros]], to apprehend Caeleb, plotting to utilize Caeleb's power to resurrect the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Valik Kodank]]. Accompanied by two [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] and several [[Nek/Legends|nek battle dogs]] and with orders from Rystra to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Caeleb's parents, Skaros raided the family's home. At the Whiphid's direction, his nek dogs swarmed over Caeleb's mother and killed her, with Caeleb observing her death from a window. Anguished at witnessing his spouse's demise, Caeleb's father was soon also slain by the Whiphid, though Skaros was ultimately prevented from apprehend the child due to the timely arrival of agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] insurgent group. At Caeleb's request, the Rebels buried the bodies of his mother and father beneath Duumas' tree, which Caeleb believed would allow his parents to take care of each other in death.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caeleb's mother appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] roleplaying adventure ''[[Child of Light]]'', which was written by [[Lee Pickler]] and published in [[2000]] by [[RPGA]] as the first adventure in the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]] roleplaying trilogy.<ref name="Child of Light" /> She was also mentioned in [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']]<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> and [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']],<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> the second<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and third adventures of the trilogy,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> published in [[2001]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and [[2002]] respectively.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> None of the three ''Child of Light'' saga adventures identify the woman's name.<ref name="Child of Light" /><ref name="Soulsaber" /><ref name="Light and Dark" />
